title: Six-site structured-volume extension of the actual Q3 generator pairing
question: Does the full-generator Kubo-Mori D/delta-D pairing remain bounded when the actual Q3 history is extended from the edge and square to the registered six-site 2x3 graph over an increasing cutoff family?

model.graph: registered six-site 2x3 rectangular grid with seven bonds
model.cutoff: replace only bond coordinates by the smooth cosine cutoff q_L; W_L=H-H_L for radius 0.5,1,2,4
model.history: D_sigma(t)=U_(H+sigma W_L)(t) A_2 U_(H+sigma W_L)(t)^* - U_H(t) A_2 U_H(t)^*
model.kubo_mori_inner_product: <A,B>_KM=2 sum_ij L(p_i,p_j) conjugate(A_ij) B_ij in the H Gibbs eigenbasis

adversarial_review.check: The six-site graph is the registered 2x3 graph with seven bonds, and the observable support remains exactly sites 0,1.
Radii 0.5,1,2,4 are evaluated with the same cosine cutoff and both signs; radius growth is a finite diagnostic only.
The i[H,·]/hbar convention and Kubo-Mori skew-adjoint pairing are retained from R310 and independently rebuilt spectrally.
The six-site versus four-site ratio is compared to the committed R310 baseline but is not promoted to an asymptotic lower bound.
Finite oscillator dimension three and one beta value are explicit; no continuum, beta-uniform or cutoff-removal claim is made.
Uniform direct Cauchy, modular domain, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks exact rational graph/cutoff and spectral pairing fixtures; the six-site matrix computation and all thermodynamic/QFT conclusions remain finite-only.

qft_interface.closed: A six-site actual-Q3 two-orientation D/delta-D history audit over an increasing cutoff family with full-generator Kubo-Mori cancellation.
qft_interface.open: A source/volume/beta-uniform direct-Cauchy theorem, modular domain transfer, product/core density, exhaustion independence, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS identification, gap, continuum and Pre-A.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Six-site finite extension and growth diagnostic only; no asymptotic no-go or common dynamics theorem.

no_overclaim: This extends the valid finite pairing identity to the registered six-site graph and reports its comparison with the square baseline. It does not close uniform direct D/delta-D control or any downstream QFT, Sector A, or Pre-A gate.
